🚀 About Team SHINE

We are Team SHINE, a passionate and creative team of university students from Jazan, Saudi Arabia, interested in technology, innovation, and space exploration.

Our interests include Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Cybersecurity, Data Analysis, and creating innovative digital solutions to real-world challenges.

We believe in teamwork, creativity, and turning ideas into practical solutions. We are excited to participate in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026
